sample.method: Failing ids from validate judges --seeds 1..20 --hidden --all-levels --blind (failingItems, deduplicated); quarantined families rubric, budget, evidence, turns, pairwise and contract/probability-above-one excluded; ids sorted lexicographically; Fisher-Yates from the last index down with mulberry32 seed 7; first 30 taken.
